# specfold

> One CLI for a repository's design, planning and maintenance documents, built for people and AI agents.

specfold is a command-line tool, `spec`. Every command takes `--help` and `--json`; `spec help --json` describes them all.

## Commands

- [spec context](docs/reference/commands.md): The documents that govern code paths: read this before changing code
- [spec find](docs/reference/commands.md): Find documents by words, type, owner, status or tag
- [spec show](docs/reference/commands.md): Frontmatter, outline, one section, or relations of a document
- [spec resolve](docs/reference/commands.md): Resolve an id, alias, path or slug to one document
- [spec graph](docs/reference/commands.md): Graph queries: impact, chain, governs; or the whole graph
- [spec owners](docs/reference/commands.md): Owners, their documents and where public owners store theirs
- [spec assets](docs/reference/commands.md): Agent skills, rules, subagents and instruction files declared under [[assets]]
- [spec log](docs/reference/commands.md): The history of a document's status and relations, from git
- [spec new](docs/reference/commands.md): Create a document at the place its owner and type decide
- [spec set](docs/reference/commands.md): Change frontmatter with the lifecycle enforced
- [spec edit](docs/reference/commands.md): Replace or append to a section or the whole body; previews until --write
- [spec mv](docs/reference/commands.md): Move or rename a document and rewrite every reference to it
- [spec fix](docs/reference/commands.md): Apply fixes that need no judgement
- [spec sync](docs/reference/commands.md): Copy asset sources over the [[assets]] roots that declare copy_of; previews until --write
- [spec attach](docs/reference/commands.md): Register files with a document, in the repository or the store
- [spec fetch](docs/reference/commands.md): Download a document's stored attachments, verified by hash
- [spec files](docs/reference/commands.md): A document's attachments and where each is kept
- [spec init](docs/reference/commands.md): Write a starter spec.toml, or upgrade an existing one
- [spec import](docs/reference/commands.md): Bring documents from another layout in through an import map
- [spec check](docs/reference/commands.md): Run the rules
- [spec verify](docs/reference/commands.md): Run sot verify commands
- [spec guard](docs/reference/commands.md): Run guards over files and commit messages
- [spec audit](docs/reference/commands.md): Diagnose what passes the rules yet needs attention; build review packs; record audits
- [spec census](docs/reference/commands.md): Counts of documents, references and attachments
- [spec doctor](docs/reference/commands.md): Read-only setup diagnosis: configuration, conflict markers, ignored local documents
- [spec explain](docs/reference/commands.md): Why a rule exists and how to fix it; or the configuration keys
- [spec schema](docs/reference/commands.md): Document types and their frontmatter; or output schema names
- [spec help](docs/reference/commands.md): Commands and arguments; with --json, the whole command tree
- [spec agents](docs/reference/commands.md): The lines to put in an agent's instruction file
- [spec hook](docs/reference/commands.md): Hook snippets for git, pre-commit, lefthook or husky
- [spec plugins](docs/reference/commands.md): Configured plugins and what they provide
- [spec export](docs/reference/commands.md): Export through an exporter plugin
- [spec mcp](docs/reference/commands.md): Serve these commands as MCP tools over stdio

## Docs

- [Concepts](docs/concepts/index.md): types, ids, statuses and relations
- [Agent assets](docs/guides/agents.md): skills, rules, subagents and instruction files
